title: Competition Avoidance vs. Herding in Job Search: Evidence from Large-Scale Field Experiments on an Online Job Board
eligible_reason: Three randomized field experiments on a job board (plus a survey choice experiment) that randomize information shown at the application/vacancy level. Regressions use experiment, application-order, vacancy-age and vacancy fixed effects on cross-sectional application data. No units adopting a binary treatment at staggered calendar dates.
design_notes: Fixed effects are experiment, order-of-application, vacancy age and vacancy FE. The 'two-way fixed effects' flag arises from vacancy and application-order FE in randomized-experiment regressions, not a staggered DiD.
estimators_reported: randomized experiment regressions with fixed effects
screener_notes: Ineligible: randomized experiments, no staggered adoption. Platform data likely proprietary.
